text:
```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  build-and-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org/'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install --only=prod

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Generate changelog
        run: npx semantic-release-changelog-generator > CHANGELOG.md

      - name: Bump version and create release
        run: npx semantic-release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: npm publish
        env:
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

      - name: Post-release announcement
        run: |
          curl -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"text": "🚀 New version released! 🚀"}' \
            https://api.twist.chat/v1/channels/YOUR_CHANNEL_ID/messages
        env:
          TWIST_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TWIST_API_KEY }}
```

This workflow is designed to replace `release-please` with `semantic-release` for automated versioning, changelog generation, and npm publishing. It includes steps to generate a changelog, bump the version, create a release, publish to npm, and post a release announcement on Twist. Make sure to update the `TWIST_API_KEY` and `YOUR_CHANNEL_ID` environment variables accordingly.
